# cb:b043

> Canonical enum of artifact URI schemes. Each scheme declared inline with its URI form. The enum is closed: no artifact value with a scheme outside this set is permitted on active beliefs.

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** enum-registry · **Domain:** system · **Status:** superseded
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `enum`, `artifact-scheme`
**Created:** 2026-06-09

**Artifact:** [`document:plans/cb-codepath/plan-1-schema-groundwork.md`](../../../plans/cb-codepath/plan-1-schema-groundwork.md)

## Invariants

- Exactly one rule entry, with field 'artifact-scheme'.
- Each value matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/.
- Values are unique within the entry.
- Every value has a corresponding entry in the definitions map.
- For all active beliefs b where b.artifact is not null: scheme(b.artifact) is in values.

## Rules

```json
{
  "definitions": {
    "code": "An anchored site within a repository file. Form: code:<repo-relative-path>#<anchor>. Everything after the first '#' is one opaque literal substring anchor (the fixed-string grep target); an optional trailing '@<N>' selects the Nth match, and a literal trailing '@<digits>' is percent-encoded as '%40<digits>'. Line numbers are never stored - they resolve at render/run time. document: remains the whole-file reference.",
    "document": "A repository file reference. Form: document:<repo-relative-path>. Files under ops/, dates/, lib/, etc.",
    "gmail": "A Gmail thread reference. Form: gmail:<thread-id>. Resolved via Gmail API.",
    "https": "An external URL. Form: https:<URL-rest>. Web pages, papers, external resources.",
    "plan": "A plan/spec/intent reference. Form: plan:<id-or-descriptor>.",
    "session": "A working session reference. Form: session:<date-or-descriptor>. Resolved via session transcript (persistence pipeline pending).",
    "source": "A cached source document reference. Form: source:<slug>. Documents stored under ops/sources/ or similar.",
    "user": "A direct user statement. Form: user:<name>:<date>. Internal authorship provenance."
  },
  "field": "artifact-scheme",
  "values": [
    "gmail",
    "session",
    "user",
    "document",
    "source",
    "https",
    "plan",
    "code"
  ]
}
```
